title: Davinci optimization remarks
description: A pipeline run's optimization remarks (P3-13): every remark a pass emitted through the pass manager's observer channel, in canonical order (emitting pass's run position, then span start ascending, span end descending, then remark name). Produced by RemarkLog::to_json - `davinci-opt --remarks <path>` writes it. The text twin is the `[remarks]` folio page; both serialize the same RemarkLog. Grammar, kinds and the per-pass vocabulary: davinci-road/plan/remarks-format.md. Consumers negotiate schema_version before reading remarks and refuse a mismatch loudly (devtool.md data layer).

schema_version.description: Remark document format version. Incompatible shape changes bump this.

stage.description: Stage of the pipeline whose pass emitted the remark (`s2`).

pass.description: The emitting pass, as the pass manager attributed it (`hoist-static`).

kind.description: applied: the pass performed (or, for an analysis pass, established) the optimization; missed: it was considered and did not apply, args name the blocker; analysis: a neutral explanatory fact.

name.description: The remark's identity within its pass, from the registered vocabulary (`static-subtree`).

span.description: Authored span the decision is about: byte offsets into the source the pipeline's artifact was lowered from.

args.description: Structured arguments in emission order; keys are unique within a remark.
